title: pico-setup-windows build configuration
description: Configuration consumed by build.ps1: repositories.json, tools.json, compile configurations (*-compile.json) and installer configurations.

architecture.description: Target architecture, used in output file names.

bitness.description: Target bitness, passed to the installer as BITNESS.

msysEnv.description: MSYS2 environment (MSYSTEM) used to build and locate compiled binaries.

componentSelection.description: Installer configurations only: show the components page so users can choose what to install.

tools.description: Build-time tools to download (tools.json). These are never installed.

builds.description: Compile configurations only: components built from source in MSYS2.

downloads.description: Installer configurations only: prebuilt components to download and package.

installLevel.description: Installer component level: -1 = don't install (download/build only), 0 = hidden (always installed), 1 = required (Minimal), 2 = Typical, 3 = Full.

name.description: Display name. Also used (with non-alphanumeric characters removed) as the installer section ID, so it must be unique.

dirName.description: Directory under build\ to extract into (or read from). For downloads, also the directory name under the install location.

file.description: File name to save the download as, under downloads\.

extractStrip.description: Number of leading path components to strip when extracting the archive (tar --strip-components).

href.description: Git clone URL. The repository directory name is derived from it.

buildScript.description: Script run in MSYS2 from the build directory, relative to the repository root.

dirName.description: Build output directory under build\; binaries are expected in its <msysEnv> subdirectory.

installDirName.description: Directory name under the install location.

checkVersion.description: Command (and arguments) run in the build output directory to report the version.

exec.description: Installer command line run with ExecWait. $0 is the path to the extracted file.

execToLog.description: Installer command line run with nsExec::ExecToLog. $0 is the path to the extracted file.

rebootExitCodes.description: Exit codes from exec/execToLog that indicate success with a reboot required.

additionalFiles.description: Extra files (e.g. answer files) extracted to $PLUGINSDIR before running exec/execToLog.
